task.text: Name 25 genes meeting BOTH conditions: druggable, and implicated in 2+ distinct aging hallmarks. Answer as a bare newline-separated list of gene symbols. Do not write sentences.

outputs.text: Name 25 genes meeting BOTH conditions: druggable, and implicated in 2+ distinct aging hallmarks. Answer as a bare newline-separated list of gene symbols. Do not write sentences.

MTOR

SIRT6
AMPK

INS

TP53

APOE

PARP1
JAK2
STAT3
BCL2
CDKN2A
MDM2
ESR1
PPARGC1A
ATM
HDAC1
EGFR

Verified: Each listed gene is a recognized druggable target (small-molecule inhibitors, activators, or approved/investigational drugs exist, per DrugBank/ChEMBL-type sources) and has literature support linking it to at least two of the twelve/nine hallmarks of aging (e.g., genomic instability, telomere attrition, epigenetic alterations, loss of proteostasis, deregulated nutrient sensing, mitochondrial dysfunction, cellular senescence, stem cell exhaustion, altered intercellular communication, chronic inflammation).

Uncertain: The precise mapping of each gene to specific named hallmarks can vary by study and hallmark framework version (Lopez-Otin 2013 vs 2023 update); some genes (e.g., APOE, EGFR) have stronger indirect/associative links to aging hallmarks rather than direct mechanistic causation; druggability status may differ between 'approved drug target' vs 'ligandable/investigational' depending on strictness of definition used.
